description: A first-order theory \(T\) is preserved under embeddings of nonempty structures into its nonempty models if and only if every nonempty substructure of each nonempty model of \(T\) is again a model of \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.substructure_preserved_iff_inclusions.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.SubstructurePreserved T ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.SubstructureInclusionPreserved T
